translations.about.heading: How can I help you?
translations.about.intro: I build digital tools that drive your business forward. From modern websites and advanced applications to intelligent AI automation - I deliver solutions ready for tomorrow's challenges.
translations.about.card.web.title: Web Development
translations.about.card.web.description: Modern websites that deliver results I create fast, responsive, and SEO-optimized websites and e-commerce platforms. My focus is not just on aesthetics, but on high conversion rates and intuitive UX that turns visitors into loyal customers.
translations.about.card.apps.title: Mobile & Desktop Apps
translations.about.card.apps.description: Software tailored to your needs I build high-performance native and cross-platform applications designed to streamline your daily operations. Whether you need a custom internal tool or a mobile app for your users - I deliver a product that just works.
translations.about.card.ai.title: AI Implementation
translations.about.card.ai.description: AI & Automation for your business I help you leverage the power of AI to gain a competitive edge. From intelligent AI agents, MCPs, and process automation to data insights - I implement solutions that save you time and make your business operate smarter and more efficiently.
